title: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Individual warm chocolate cakes with a molten, flowing centre. Elegant enough for a dinner party, easy enough for a weeknight.

ingredients.text: 150g unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
Vanilla ice cream or cream, to serve

steps: Preheat oven to 200°C. Butter 4 ramekins and dust with cocoa powder, tapping out any excess.
Melt chocolate and butter together in a heatproof bowl over simmering water. Stir until smooth and let cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, yolks, and sugar until pale and thick, about 3 minutes.
Fold chocolate mixture into the egg mixture, then sift in flour and fold until just combined.
Divide batter among ramekins. At this point they can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours.
Bake 10–12 minutes until the edges are set but the centre still has a wobble.
Run a knife around the edge, invert onto plates, and serve immediately with ice cream.
notes: Baking time is critical — 10 mins for very runny, 12 for just-set. Test with one ramekin first if unsure of your oven.
